description: This PHP class 'Rating' in the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Task\Report' manages tasks related to product rating reports. It includes methods to generate a list of rating tasks ('index') and to calculate/update product ratings ('list').

classes.name: Rating
classes.description: Manages rating report related tasks such as generating task lists and calculating product ratings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of rating report tasks based on total products, dividing them into pages and creating tasks for each chunk.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Calculates and updates ratings for products based on provided arguments, returning a success message with progress.
